answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by gating franchise on attested original work rather than account count. Each epoch, an address must publish a unique answer and wait for peer seals before it can grade or vote. A swarm can mint keys in a meadow of cheap identities, but it cannot cheaply write a credible sonnet of original reasoning at the quality summit peers actually attest. Until that trail exists, new accounts stay mute and their stake stays locked.
